_doc.zh: 用来对照的已发表数据：在体压入的力–位移、体位改变的位移量级。只收本项目打开过原文的数值；找不到的如实写明。
_doc.en: Published data to compare against: in-vivo indentation force–displacement and the scale of posture-induced displacement. Only numbers whose text this project opened; what was not found is said so.

site.zh: 前臂，脂肪最厚处（该文的 P2）
site.en: forearm, the high-fat-thickness site (P2 of the paper)

indentation.where: section 2.5 (prescribed 5 mm minus 0.5 mm gap) and the note of Table 8

caveat.zh: 单个受试者；该点在前臂上的确切位置没有在打开的文字里给出，本项目取前臂掌侧中段。
caveat.en: One subject; the exact position of the site on the forearm is not given in the text opened, so the mid volar forearm is used here.

site.zh: 前臂，肌肉最厚处（该文的 P3）
site.en: forearm, the high-muscle-thickness site (P3 of the paper)

indentation.where: section 2.5 (prescribed 3.5 mm minus 0.3 mm gap) and the note of Table 9

site.zh: 手，皮肤为主的点（该文的 P1）
site.en: hand, the skin-dominant site (P1 of the paper)

indentation.where: section 2.5 and the note of Table 7

caveat.zh: 没有模拟：手部的软组织比笼子的单元还薄。
caveat.en: Not simulated: the soft tissue of the hand is thinner than a cage cell.

caveat.zh: 转述的数值，压头和载荷范围未知；足跟垫厚度与笼子单元同量级，没有模拟。
caveat.en: A quoted value with unknown indenter and load range; the heel pad is about one cage cell thick and was not simulated.

site.zh: 腹部，脐的高度、腹直肌中央（该文的 R2），仰卧放松
site.en: abdomen, centre of the rectus abdominis at the level of the umbilicus (R2 of the paper), supine and relaxed

forcePolynomialN.note: f(δ) = f1·δ⁴ + f2·δ³ + f3·δ² + f4·δ, δ in mm

indentation.where: Table 4 (mean curve fit of region R2); Table 6: inverse Ogden fit c = 7 kPa, m = 17

caveat.zh: 十名 25–37 岁男性的平均曲线。表 4 的 RMSE 列单位写的是 N/mm；个体曲线和取值范围只在该文的图 4 和补充材料里，没有读取，所以这里没有受试者间的离散范围。
caveat.en: The mean curve of ten males aged 25–37. The RMSE column of Table 4 is labelled N/mm; individual curves and value ranges are only in Figure 4 and the supplement of the paper and were not read, so no between-subject spread is given here.

site.zh: 腹部，脐下、腹直肌中央（该文的 R3），仰卧放松
site.en: abdomen, centre of the rectus abdominis below the umbilicus (R3 of the paper), supine and relaxed

forcePolynomialN.note: f(δ) = f1·δ² + f2·δ, δ in mm

notFound.zh: 大腿、乳房、臀部的在体压入力–位移曲线没有找到开放获取、可直接取数的来源。四肢 100 名受试者的压入数据（neumann2018）：论文说动态数据站需要注册并经管理员批准（没有注册）；DOI 10.18735/S5R97F 指向的静态存档 archive.simtk.org/multis/ 不需要账号就能浏览，按受试者分目录存放原始记录，本次没有下载和处理（要用该项目自己的脚本逐次试验处理，存档页上也没有找到许可声明）。腹部站立与仰卧轮廓的已发表数值仍然没有找到。
notFound.en: No open, directly usable in-vivo indentation force–displacement curves were found for thigh, breast or buttock. The limb indentation data of 100 subjects (neumann2018): the paper says the dynamic data site needs registration approved by an administrator (no account was created); the static archive behind DOI 10.18735/S5R97F, archive.simtk.org/multis/, can be browsed without an account and holds raw records in per-subject directories, which were not downloaded or processed here (they need the project's own scripts trial by trial, and no licence statement was found on the archive page). Published numbers for the abdominal profile standing versus supine were still not found.

what.zh: 乳房内标志点从俯卧到仰卧的位移（刚性对齐之后）
what.en: displacement of landmarks inside the breast from prone to supine (after rigid alignment)

posture.where: abstract; Table 3 (initial TRE by group) and Table 4 (shear modulus per case)

use.zh: 俯卧到仰卧，重力反转（变化 2g）。本项目直接模拟俯卧和仰卧两个状态再相减，不再用线性换算。站立到仰卧（重力转 90°，变化 √2·g）该文没有数据；按线性比例约为 0.71 倍只是本项目的推算，大变形下不成立。受试者是乳腺癌患者，乳房体积在打开的段落里没有给出；该文的乳房可沿胸壁滑动，本模型里乳房底面粘在胸壁上。
use.en: Prone to supine reverses gravity (a change of 2g). This project now simulates the prone and the supine state and takes the difference instead of scaling linearly. The paper has no standing-to-supine data (gravity turned by 90°, a change of √2·g); the factor 0.71 by linear scaling is this project's inference only and does not hold at large deformation. The subjects are breast cancer patients whose breast volume is not given in the passages opened; the breast of that paper may slide along the chest wall, whereas here its base is bonded to it.

note.en: The paper's text says 547 and its figure caption 574.

muscle.where: results and discussion paragraphs; the example is Fig. 3 of the paper

forearm2026.citation: Development and Surface Indentation Assessment of an MRI-Based Subject-Specific Hand–Forearm Finite Element Model: A Preliminary Study. Bioengineering (Basel) 2026.
forearm2026.opened: full text (Europe PMC XML): abstract, section 2.3–2.5, Table 4 and the notes of Tables 7–9

note.zh: 单个健康成年男性受试者；作者自称初步研究。表 4 的本构参数是该文从别的文献里取的候选值，那些原始文献本项目没有打开。
note.en: One healthy adult male volunteer; called a preliminary study by its authors. The constitutive parameters of its Table 4 are candidates taken from other papers, which this project did not open.

proneSupine2016.citation: Eiben B et al. Symmetric Biomechanically Guided Prone-to-Supine Breast Image Registration. Ann Biomed Eng 2016.
proneSupine2016.opened: full text: abstract, Tables 3 and 4 and the surrounding paragraphs

note.zh: 14 组临床影像（9 组俯卧 MRI–仰卧 CT、1 组 CT、4 组 MRI）；刚性对齐后的标志点距离即俯卧到仰卧的组织位移量级。受试者是乳腺癌患者，乳房体积没有在打开的段落里给出。
note.en: Fourteen clinical image pairs (nine prone MRI–supine CT, one CT, four MRI); the landmark distance after rigid alignment is the scale of tissue motion from prone to supine. The subjects are breast cancer patients; breast volume is not given in the passages opened.

vastus2014.citation: Shear Modulus Estimation on Vastus Intermedius of Elderly and Young Females over the Entire Range of Isometric Contraction. PLoS One 2014.
vastus2014.opened: full text: results and discussion paragraphs with the shear moduli

note.zh: 振动超声剪切波法，沿肌纤维方向的剪切模量；该文正文两处对老年组和青年组的放松值写法相反（9.5±3.3 与 12.8±5.4 kPa），这里只取范围。
note.en: Vibro-ultrasound shear waves, shear modulus along the fibres; the paper's text assigns the two relaxed values (9.5±3.3 and 12.8±5.4 kPa) to the elderly and the young group inconsistently in two places, so only the range is used here.

heelSex2020.opened: full text: discussion sentence quoting Borros & Challis 2003

note.zh: 只取了它转述的一组数（足跟垫刚度），压头形状和载荷范围在打开的句子里没有给出。
note.en: Only one quoted pair of numbers (heel pad stiffness) was taken; indenter shape and load range are not given in the sentence opened.

remus2024.opened: full text XML: sections 2.2, 2.7, 2.8, Tables 2, 4 and 6

waterJet2012.opened: full text XML: introduction with Eq. (1) and Table 1

note.zh: 只取了数值；许可不允许改编再分发，原文没有入库。作者和期刊按 Europe PMC 的记录填写。
note.en: Numbers only; the licence does not allow adapted redistribution and no text is committed. Authors and journal as in the Europe PMC record.

neumann2018.citation: Neumann EE, et al. Reference data on thickness and mechanics of tissue layers and anthropometry of musculoskeletal extremities. Sci Data 2018. doi:10.1038/sdata.2018.193
neumann2018.opened: full text XML: data records and usage notes; the landing page of the static archive

note.en: The data themselves were not used.

analytic.formula: F = 2·a·E·δ·κ(ν, a/h) / (1 − ν²); κ → 1 for a/h → 0 (elastic half-space)

caveat.zh: 该文表 1 的 k 值是它自己的水射流压头的有限元结果（a/h = 0.17 时 k < 1），不是刚性压头的 Hayes κ，所以没有采用；Hayes 原文的 κ 表没有打开。本项目的解析算例只用 κ > 1 这一性质和网格收敛。
caveat.en: The k values of Table 1 of that paper are finite-element results for its own water-jet indenter (k < 1 at a/h = 0.17), not Hayes' κ for a rigid punch, so they are not used; the κ table of Hayes' paper was not opened. The analytic cases of this project use only κ > 1 and mesh convergence.

what.zh: 跑步时小腿软组织标志点相对骨段的位移（峰–峰）
what.en: displacement of soft-tissue markers on the calf relative to the segment in running (peak to peak)

softTissueMotion.where: discussion: compression reduced calf displacement by 1.3 mm (~13 %), up to 1.9 mm (~20 %) and 1.8 mm (~11 %)

caveat.zh: 表 2 的数值在打开的 XML 里读不出来；这里的无压缩对照值是由正文里“减少的毫米数 ÷ 减少的百分比”反推的，只作量级用：跑步时软组织相对骨的摆动是一到两厘米。
caveat.en: The numbers of its Table 2 could not be read from the XML opened; the control values here are back-computed from the text's “millimetres reduced ÷ per cent reduced” and serve for the order of magnitude only: soft tissue swings by one to two centimetres relative to bone in running.
